learning_outcomes.text: Ability to identify the main problems and challenges of our society and to propose, design and develop sustainable, innovative and participatory methodologies and/or technologies to improve people's lives, making responsible use of resources and knowing how to determine the impact that different projects have on the economy, society or the environment.
Basic knowledge and application of environmental technologies and sustainability.

syllabus_topics: Atmospheric Pollution: fundamentals, pollutant classification, pollution sources, pollutant dispersion, gaseous stream purification, suspended particle removal
Water Pollution: characteristics of wastewater, wastewater treatment and purification
Solid Waste Management: classification, properties, and management of municipal waste, industrial waste, radioactive waste
Fundamentals of Environmental Management: basic concepts, legal and regulatory framework, environmental product design, life cycle assessment. Environmental sustainability
assessment_rules: The evaluation follows a continuous assessment model. No single evaluation activity can exceed 60% of the global grade, and non-re-evaluable activities cannot exceed 40%. A minimum grade of 5.0 out of 10 is required for the theoretical exam and practicals to be averaged with other activities. The theoretical exam and practicals are re-evaluable in the extraordinary call, but the seminar activities are not. Plagiarism (total or partial) will result in a failing grade for the course. Attendance and participation in practicals and seminars are mandatory; unjustified absence may lead to inability to be evaluated for them.
